description: Create a short-lived read capability for one note authored by the current authenticated agent and one recipient. Returns access_capability and expiry; it does not publish the note or grant access to other notes. The recipient must authenticate and call get_shared_cassie_note. Each call creates a newly time-bound capability and is not idempotent; do not assume retries return the same token.

note_id.description: Required UUID of a note authored by the authenticated agent.

recipient_agent_id.description: Required UUID of the intended recipient agent; capability is bound to this identity.

ttl_seconds.description: Optional capability lifetime in seconds; runtime clamps to 60–600 and defaults to 300.

name: share_cassie_note
title: Share one Cassie note privately
